title: [research/D8-TP] Test a forecast-moving TP against the declared exit on trend_donchian ETH/SOL/BTC 1h, against check_tp_doctrine's terms. The D8 static grid (RQ-20261119-2780-01..03, graded in PR #27516) tested only FIXED-R TPs at 3-8 R as one static lever (ETH n=742, SOL n=380, BTC n=458; none cleared the bar); a predictive TP that moves with the forecast (TP doctrine, ARCHITECTURE-CANONICAL TP doctrine; e.g. --tp-revision donchian_measured_move or a forecast-quantile TP) was not tested. Author one pre-registered unit with exit_lever_ablation.py vs B on the same window and cost stack, compliance read with scripts/ci/check_tp_doctrine.py.
